title: The Speaking Up for a Fair Turn
youtube_title: The Speaking Up for a Fair Turn | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Trying the smallest brave step still counts.
summary: At a bakery counter facing the street, Nim feels shy about speaking up so a quieter child got a turn. Instead of pretending not to care, Nim tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while the ferryman stays kind and does not push for a show.
